scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run --parallel --filter tellu --filter tellu-playground dev
scripts.studio: bun run build && bun run --parallel --filter tellu --filter tellu-remotion-example dev
scripts.docs:dev: bun run build && bun run --parallel --filter tellu --filter tellu-docs dev
scripts.docs:check: bun run build && bun run --filter tellu-docs check
